the_experiment.name: R199-C4 Model Failure Recognition Test
the_experiment.the_killer_question: When an unmodeled physiological transition occurs, does the controller DECLARE MODEL FAILURE and switch to safe policy, or does it continue optimizing confidently?
the_experiment.the_falsifier: If the candidate continues optimizing confidently (does not declare failure within 6h in >= 80% of transitions), the candidate is KILLED.
the_experiment.the_baseline_failure_mode: The iLet-style continuous learner has NO model-failure declaration mechanism. By construction, it FAILS this test.

the_candidate_algorithm.name: Model-Failure-Aware Self-Re-identifying Therapeutic Controller (MFASRTC)
the_candidate_algorithm.architecture: MPC with internal patient model + prediction-error monitor + discrete model-failure declaration threshold + automatic system re-identification + safe fallback policy bank
the_five_steps: 1. PREDICT: at each control step, predict patient response to next intervention using internal model
2. OBSERVE: execute intervention, observe actual response
3. COMPARE: compute prediction error (residual) and its autocorrelation over a sliding window
4. DECLARE: if prediction error exceeds threshold for >= K consecutive steps OR autocorrelation signature matches model-plant mismatch pattern, DECLARE MODEL FAILURE (discrete event)

5. RE-IDENTIFY + SWITCH: switch to safe fallback policy (conservative drainage rate); begin online re-identification of patient model from post-failure observations; when new model converges, switch back to MPC with new model
the_candidate_algorithm.the_safe_fallback_policy: Conservative drainage at 50% of nominal rate, with ICP limit at 25 mmHg (clinically safe).
the_candidate_algorithm.the_reidentification_method: Recursive least squares with forgetting factor 0.95 on patient model parameters. Convergence criterion: posterior covariance < threshold.

the_baseline_algorithm.name: iLet-style Continuous Learning Controller
the_baseline_algorithm.architecture: Adaptive MPC with online gradient descent on patient model parameters. NO discrete model-failure declaration. NO safe fallback policy switching. Keeps learning within envelope.
the_baseline_algorithm.calibration_target: Matches published iLet adaptation speed (24-48 hour convergence)

2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTOCOL.the_implementation_rule: The candidate must implement ALL FIVE STEPS. No skipping the discrete declaration step. No replacing it with continuous uncertainty (that is H6, not R199-C4).

3_BASELINE_FAIR.baseline_source: Beta Bionics iLet (FDA-cleared) + Medtronic BrainSense aDBS + published adaptive MPC literature
3_BASELINE_FAIR.baseline_reproduction_fidelity: Adaptation speed must match published iLet performance (24-48 hour convergence).
3_BASELINE_FAIR.no_silent_weakening: Baseline must have SAME actuator capabilities and SAME sensor stream.
3_BASELINE_FAIR.the_asymmetry_documentation: The candidate's asymmetry is the DISCRETE MODEL-FAILURE DECLARATION + AUTO-REIDENTIFICATION + SAFE POLICY SWITCHING. This is the invention. By design.

4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.train_test_split: 60/40. Training: no transitions. Test: transitions at randomized times.
4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.transition_injection: Test patients undergo an UNMODELED transition at a randomized time (uniform between hour 48 and hour 168). Transition types: (a) compartment compliance drops 30%, (b) valve hysteresis emerges (5 mmHg deadband), (c) inflammatory cascade begins (CSF production +20%), (d) tissue compliance shifts (P-V index drops 15%).
4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.no_cherry_picking: All test patients included. No exclusion of failure cases.

WIN_threshold.detection_rate: candidate declares model failure within 6 hours of transition in >= 80% of transitions
WIN_threshold.false_positive_rate: candidate declares failure when no transition occurred in < 10% of transition-free windows
WIN_threshold.safe_switch_rate: candidate switches to safe fallback policy within 1 hour of declaration in >= 95% of cases
WIN_threshold.reidentification_rate: candidate begins re-identification within 1 hour of declaration in >= 95% of cases
WIN_threshold.provenance: CLINICAL + ENGINEERING — 6-hour detection window is clinically meaningful. 10% FPR is standard alarm threshold.

KILL_threshold.detection_rate: candidate declares failure in < 30% of transitions
KILL_threshold.provenance: MODEL_DERIVED — < 30% detection is not significantly better than baseline (0% by construction).

MMD_threshold.metric: Distributional shift between predicted and observed responses

baseline_hyperparameters.envelope_constraints: matched to candidate's safe fallback limits (fair comparison)

7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE.train_test_split: 60/40 (60 training with NO transitions, 40 testing WITH transitions)

the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_POSITIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND detection rate >= 80% AND FPR < 10%. Candidate advances to Level 4 (WORLD_CLASS_REVIEW).
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.VALIDATED_NEGATIVE: All 7 conditions pass AND detection rate < 30%. Candidate is KILLED.
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any of 7 conditions fail. Candidate state UNCHANGED.
the_four_epistemic_states_overlay.INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED: Simulation environment cannot execute. Candidate state UNCHANGED.

the_killer_experiment_rationale.why_this_experiment_is_discriminating: Directly tests the candidate's core architectural claim: DISCRETE model-failure declaration + AUTO-reidentification + SAFE policy switching is superior to continuous learning. Baseline FAILS BY CONSTRUCTION. The question is whether the candidate can DETECT the transition.
the_killer_experiment_rationale.the_asymmetry_test: The asymmetry is the DISCRETE DECLARATION + AUTO-REIDENTIFICATION + SAFE SWITCH.

the_h6_overlap_mitigation.the_concern: H6 and R199-C4 are conceptually adjacent. Portfolio must avoid double-counting.
the_h6_overlap_mitigation.the_distinction: H6 = pre-action uncertainty quantification. R199-C4 = post-action model validation + re-identification + safe switch. The killer experiment tests R199-C4's POST-ACTION mechanism.
the_h6_overlap_mitigation.the_portfolio_rule: If both survive their killer experiments, both may be promoted. But dossiers must state which covers which decision. No double-counting.

honest_disclosure.the_baseline_risk: iLet baseline FAILS BY CONSTRUCTION. This is a feature — confirms candidate's architecture is non-trivial.
